title: Governance Request Catalog & SLA Mapper — intake heuristics for redaction/retention/exports
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit a wide variety of non-bug governance requests (logging redaction, retention changes, PII handling, audit exports). We currently rely on ad-hoc triage between Support, Security, and Eng which causes inconsistent SLAs and routing. Goal: Produce a lightweight request catalog and deterministic SLA/owner mapper that can be used by Support, CSMs, and Sales engineering to route and set expectations for each request type. Deliver a documented heuristic, sample routing logic, and a small automation playbook (rules for triage) that can be implemented in our intake queue or ticketing system.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical catalog of at least 10 request archetypes with examples (redaction, retention change, export for compliance, PII discovery, pseudonymization request, audit log access, data minimization config, KMS key rotation, export for legal hold, structured export for SOC2)
For each archetype: owner team, initial SLA (response & resolution targets), required stakeholders, and likely blockers are documented
A scoring heuristic (severity, customer tier, regulatory region, complexity) that yields a routable SLA decision and triage owner
A routing matrix expressed as simple rule examples (IF-THEN) that Support can copy to the intake tool
A staging doc and one Confluence page with runbook and links to required downstream artifacts
Pilot with two enterprise customers (Sales-led) with measured response times and feedback from Support & Eng
tasks: Gather 12 months of governance request examples from Support and CSMs (owner: Marco)
Interview security/compliance SME to identify regulation-driven variants (owner: Leah Kim)
Draft request archetype catalog and example templates (owner: PM)
Design SLA scoring rubric and validate with Eng leads (owner: Marco)
Publish Confluence runbook + intake automation rules (owner: Documentation)
Run pilot with two existing enterprise customers and record SLA adherence metrics (owner: CS)
Iterate based on pilot feedback and create final handoff to Ops for queue automation (owner: Marco)
Create short training slide deck for Support and CSMs (owner: Design)
Create monitoring dashboard for triage times and customer satisfaction (owner: Analytics)
Coordinate a security review if any PII-handling workflows require product changes (owner: Security)
Ship follow-up plan for 30/60/90 day improvements post-pilot (owner: PM)
